method: Direct current-source inspection at exact repository HEADs; evidence strings are paraphrases and contain no credential values

findings.evidence: classify_schema() treats top-level model/providers.*.api_key_env as supported legacy input, and parse_provider_model_config() returns None for legacy-only mappings
findings.required_change: Delete legacy/mixed mode support; validate canonical providers/models/defaults only and reject unsupported inputs

findings.evidence: ResolvedAgentProfile stores loose model/fallback/provider mappings and exports settings, primary, and fallback compatibility projections instead of exact route identities
findings.required_change: Expose exact primary/fallback routes and CLI selections; remove loose reconstruction fields and compatibility properties

findings.evidence: _legacy_load_agent_config() and public load_agent_config() merge old model/runtime mappings and retain a compatibility projection over canonical resolution
findings.required_change: Remove both LLM mapping loaders/exports and keep source primitives separate from typed canonical profile resolution

findings.evidence: model construction reads MODEL_BASE_URL/MODEL_API_KEY, accepts raw endpoint/secret/provider/model/snapshot/fallback inputs, and exposes three overlapping public factories
findings.required_change: Keep one public create_model(Model or canonical alias plus context) and move protocol/fallback construction behind private exact-route helpers

findings.evidence: the public SDK exports create_fallback_model, create_model_with_fallback, and infer_model beside create_model
findings.required_change: Remove the extra factories and infer_model re-export from imports and __all__

findings.evidence: CallerSnapshot stores mapping-shaped model authority; ConsumerRuntimeProfile stores model/settings/fallback authority and load_settings is an I/O-producing default
findings.required_change: Delete CallerSnapshot and make ConsumerRuntimeProfile pure runtime/framework state with source-free defaults

findings.evidence: build_agent imports create_model_with_fallback, loads tdt_core.load_agent_config when context is absent, reads model/provider mappings, and builds fallback authority locally
findings.required_change: Accept explicit Model or canonical alias plus complete context; delegate once to create_model without loading or comparing configuration

findings.evidence: BaseAgent publicly accepts a string default plus agent_config/settings and implements string/snapshot/config resolution guards
findings.required_change: Make BaseAgent Model-only and move every configuration/model construction responsibility to composition roots

findings.evidence: _create_runtime_model owns old model/provider/fallback/behavior mapping resolution and _run_agent_prompt loads that mapping before BaseAgent construction
findings.required_change: Remove _create_runtime_model; resolve one canonical context at CLI composition and call public build_agent/create_model

findings.evidence: HarnessConfig.load uses two-plane tdt_core.load_agent_config/load_agent_overlay LLM mapping composition and retains workspace_path for caller compatibility
findings.required_change: Separate harness domain config from LLM selection and resolve a typed construction context at the public run root

findings.evidence: build_agent(profile=stage_profile, model=context.model, ...) receives runtime profile and model string but no ModelConstructionContext
findings.required_change: Thread the run-owned context through HarnessServices/StageCompositionContext into build_agent or pass an explicit Model

findings.evidence: generation compares runtime.model/settings to loose profile fields, reconstructs provider/model/fallback mappings, calls both public factories, and retains a GenerationConfig alias
findings.required_change: Use one operation-owned context and exact routes through create_model/build_agent; remove aliases and mapping reconstruction

findings.evidence: resolve_canonical_overrides catches OSError and returns {}, explicitly preserving local reviewer settings for missing/legacy configuration
findings.required_change: Require explicit canonical mapping for enabled reviewers and propagate source/selection/projection failures before adapter construction

findings.evidence: resolve_agent_profile(root=Path(run.project_root)) interprets the contained operation target as the canonical TDT configuration root
findings.required_change: Resolve from the consumer-owned canonical TDT root and keep run.project_root target-only
